How to use this app

1️⃣Open a topicTap any circle on the learning path. The lesson opens with everything about that question or phrase.
2️⃣Four tabs insideSentences · Vocabulary · Grammar · Practice — swipe through them in order.
3️⃣Listen and repeat🔊 plays slow German. Switch speed in the lesson header. “Play all” reads every sentence of the topic.
4️⃣Write your own answerSave one sentence per topic — they become your speech in “My Intro”.
5️⃣Mark as learnedThe green button ticks the circle and opens the next topic. The bar at the top fills up.
6️⃣Add more videos or textsLibrary → ＋ Add a video (paste a link) or 📖 Add a story / word list. Everything you add stays on this device — back it up from Help if you want to keep it safe.
🔄Check for updatesLooks for a newer version of the app and loads it (needs internet).
🗄️Backup & restoreSave your added videos, answers and progress to a file — or bring them onto a new phone.
📲Install as an appGet a home-screen icon that opens full screen and works offline.New

Add a story or text

Paste any German text you may read — a story, a news item, your own notes. The app turns it into a lesson: every sentence gets slow audio, every word becomes tappable, and a quiz is built from the text.

Leave empty if you do not have a translation: the app looks up every word anyway.
One word per line. Separate the German word from its meaning with =, —, a tab or a comma. Pasting a list you exported from another app works fine.
